title: The localized small etale site at an etale open is the small etale site of the open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $U\to X$ be an etale $X$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $X_{\Et}/U$ be the localized site: the slice category of $X_{\Et}$ over the object $U\to X$ (objects are $X_{\Et}$-morphisms $V\to U$, morphisms are $X_{\Et}$-morphisms commuting with the maps to $U$), in which a family of morphisms covers precisely when its underlying family covers in $X_{\Et}$. The localized site $X_{\Et}/U$ is equivalent to the small etale site $U_{\Et}$: an etale $X$-scheme over $U$ is sent to its underlying etale $U$-scheme, and the inverse sends an etale $U$-scheme $V\to U$ to $V\to U\to X$. The equivalence identifies the localized Grothendieck topology with the small etale topology, and induces an equivalence of categories of sheaves of abelian groups [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves].
